title: Kayak or E-Bike? Pick for Your Group
why: Warm leads comparing a kayak tour and an e-bike ride, sorted by who's coming. Proof via real GBP rating and a real review.
hook_options: Kayak or e-bike? It depends who's coming.
Same coastline, two very different days.
Which Door County tour fits your group?
caption: Kayak if the sea caves are the point. E-bike if you'd rather stay dry and see the cliffs from above. Kids 5 and up can paddle tandem with an adult, and mixed-age groups usually love the bikes. Kayaks return May 2027, bikes are out now. #DoorCounty #CavePoint #KayakDoorCounty #EBikeDoorCounty

slides.headline: Which Door County tour fits your group?
slides.body: Same coastline, two very different days. Here's how we'd sort it.

slides.headline: You want the caves from the water.
slides.body: Cave Point's sea caves are only reachable by boat. That view doesn't exist from a trail.
slides.photo_abs: /Users/wavey/Library/Mobile Documents/iCloud~md~obsidian/Documents/Door County Kayak Tours/Assets/DCKT/DCKT Photos/Cave Point/cave point photos from guide perspective/IMG_3094.JPG

slides.headline: You'd rather stay dry and cover ground.
slides.body: About 4.5 miles to the cliffs, then Whitefish Dunes. You see the shoreline from above, not from inside it.

slides.photo_abs: /Users/wavey/Library/Mobile Documents/iCloud~md~obsidian/Documents/Door County Kayak Tours/Assets/DCKT/DCKT Photos/EBike Photos/ebike with kid carrier on door bluff ebike tour of deaths door 2.jpg

slides.headline: Kayaks start at age 5.
slides.body: Kids 5 and up ride in a tandem with an adult. On e-bikes, small kids may ride in a trailer, guide's call.

slides.headline: Never kayaked? That's most guests.
slides.body: From a July review: "some of us had anxiety and were nervous it being our first time but he made it so relaxing." Sarah J.

slides.headline: Grandparents and teens, same pace.
slides.body: The motor evens out the legs. Nobody's stuck waiting at the top of a hill.

slides.headline: Kayaks in summer. Bikes this fall.
slides.body: Kayak tours run roughly mid-May to mid-October. Right now, e-bike rentals are the ones on the calendar.

slides.headline: 4.9 stars, 1,000+ Google reviews.
slides.body: That's our Jacksonport listing as of October 2026. A lot of those reviews name the guide, which tells you what sticks.

slides.headline: Caves: kayak. Cliffs from above: e-bike.
slides.body: Little kids: tandem at 5+. Mixed ages: e-bike. Can't decide? Bike this fall, kayak next summer.

slides.headline: Book either at doorcountykayaktours.com
slides.body: Kayak tours return May 2027. E-bikes are rolling now. Send this to your group chat.
